description: Retrieve typical US consumer fee ranges by category. Use when needing a quick reference for fee benchmarks. Avoid when auditing specific fee charges, use audit_fees instead.

name: benchmark_fees

category.description: The category key looked up, e.g. bank_overdraft; or 'all' if the full table was returned.

fees.description: List of typical fee ranges for the category.
